<details>

```diff
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /Users/liamellis/Desktop/ultraterrestrial-resurrection/.cursor/rules/nextjs-pages-server-components.mdc
+---
+description: Enforce that Next.js App Router page files are Server Components and must not include 'use client'
+globs: **/app/**/page.tsx, **/app/**/page.ts
+alwaysApply: false
+---
+
+- **Pages are Server Components by default**
+  - All files named &#96;page.tsx&#96; or &#96;page.ts&#96; under the Next.js App Router &#96;app&#96; directory must be Server Components
+  - Do not add the &#96;'use client'&#96; directive at the top of any page file
+
+- **No client-only hooks or browser APIs in pages**
+  - Avoid &#96;useState&#96;, &#96;useEffect&#96;, &#96;useRef&#96;, or direct DOM access in &#96;page.tsx&#96;
+  - If interactivity is needed, move that logic into a child Client Component and import it into the page
+
+- **Composition pattern**
+  - Keep data fetching and server actions in the page (Server Component)
+  - Encapsulate interactive UI in separate components marked with &#96;'use client'&#96;
+
+- **Rationale**
+  - Reduces client bundle size, improves performance and security
+  - Aligns with Next.js App Router best practices
+
+### References (existing examples)
+
+- Baseline page example: [page.tsx](mdc:apps/app/src/app/page.tsx)
+
+### Examples
+
+&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
+// ✅ DO: Server Component page (default – no 'use client')
+export default async function Page() {
+  // Server data fetching or Server Actions here
+  return (
+    &lt;main&gt;
+      &lt;h1&gt;Server-rendered Page&lt;/h1&gt;
+      {/* Import a client component for interactivity if needed */}
+      {/* &lt;InteractiveWidget /&gt; */}
+    &lt;/main&gt;
+  )
+}
+&#96;&#96;&#96;
+
+&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
+// ❌ DON'T: Client directive in a page file
+'use client'
+
+export default function Page() {
+  // Using client-only hooks in a page is not allowed by this rule
+  // Move interactive logic into a child component instead
+  return &lt;div&gt;Interactive Page&lt;/div&gt;
+}
+&#96;&#96;&#96;
+
+&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
+// ✅ DO: Client component used by a Server Component page
+'use client'
+
+import {useState} from 'react'
+
+export function InteractiveWidget() {
+  const [count, setCount] = useState(0)
+  return (
+    &lt;button onClick={() =&gt; setCount((c) =&gt; c + 1)}&gt;Clicked {count} times&lt;/button&gt;
+  )
+}
+&#96;&#96;&#96;
+
+### Enforcement Notes
+
+- If a page requires client-side interactivity, extract those parts into a separate component with &#96;'use client'&#96; and keep the page itself as a Server Component.
+- Prefer Server Actions and server-side data fetching within pages to minimize client JavaScript.
+
*** End Patch
```

</details>
